_readme: Weekly working list of sailings. Add one object per sailing to "sailings". Fields: loadPort, destination, vessel, voyage, carrier, ets (departure), eta (arrival), lane, notes. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD. Transit time is calculated from ets/eta, do not enter it. Rows with "example": true are demo rows - delete them once real sailings are in. Bump "updated" whenever you refresh the list. "lanes" is the carrier lane directory used for the reference links lower down the page.

source.name: Carrier schedules
source.note: Sailings are compiled from published carrier schedules. All dates are carrier estimates and must be reconfirmed before a booking is committed.
